task: Extend moss.datastructures with validated ordered and search structures.
observation: The structured checker rejected a Vector push reached through an exported record field with MOSS_COMPILE_ERROR, identified the exact source line, and explicitly directed the implementation to a top-level helper; applying the package's existing helper pattern resolved the check without generated-Rust inspection.
impact: The diagnostic reduced the ownership/lowering repair to one local edit pattern before broader tests, avoiding speculative restructuring of the collection representation.

resolution.summary: Record-field Vector push/pop operations now use typed top-level helpers; Native Debug, Native Release, and Fast Debug each pass all 23 package tests.
